title: Tasting with excellent wines and cheeses
text:
100% recommended! 
They offer an excellent pairing with specific wines from each country.
Quality cheeses and charcuterie.
Very cozy atmosphere in front of the Sagrada Familia. In passing if you want to meet people, it is an excellent option
Dare to go, you won't regret it!
author: ChristianT2213

title: Excellent experience
text: Excellent experience of drinking exquisite wines and being able to contemplate the Sagrada Familia just a couple of meters away. I would like to emphasize the exceptional service provided by the girls, their cordiality, and expertise in oenology. Especially Alejandra who is really charming. Plus they even take professional photos of you. Totally recommended. They make you want to come back.
author: 637mat_asr

title: Excellent wine tasting, good conversation and a dream view!
text: Super recommended, an unforgettable experience, I have attended other wine tastings but this one surprised me, the view of the Sagrada Familia is unique, the hostesses are very friendly and concerned about every detail, I will definitely return on my next visit to Barcelona!
author: X2213CNandreag

title: Excellent wines and cheeses.
text: Excellent initiative and very good experience, the red and white wines very successful and consistent with the experience. The view of the Sagrada Familia is beautiful and the hostesses are very pleasant and attentive.
author: patriciogI938OL

title: Nice experience!!
text: It was a very pleasant experience. We went with 2 friends and met very friendly people. The winemaker explained the tasting very clearly and shared very interesting anecdotes about the city. I recommend it!
author: valentinatE152BK

title: Wine tasting with an amazing view
text: This wine tasting is on spot! The view of the Sagrada Familia is impressive. Our sommelier, Sofi, guided us through a two hour selection of wines from Italy and Spain, paired with the best accompaniments. We were greatly surprised by the history of the neighborhood and the building where the tasting takes place, as well as the deep knowledge about each wine and its regions. I highly recommend it 100%!
author: camilar943

title: An excellent wine tasting at the foot of the Sagrada Familia
text: The experience takes place in a very welcoming environment. The space is really beautiful and you can admire the imposing Sagrada Familia throughout the tasting. Sofía and Alejandra welcomed us with a glass of cava and explained a little about the city, the neighborhood and the monument that can be seen in the foreground from the balcony. Then we move on to the tasting. The wines were top-notch and paired perfectly with delicious tapas. title: Excelente!
text: I Really enjoyed  this event.  I had the opportunity  to taste several wines 🍷from several countries  which made the experience  globally. Also I learn a lot from cultures  and backgrounds  from vineyards themselves.  the view to sagrada is great, the staff is so friendly 👌 and the flat is really cool. It is a great opportunity  to taste wine and make new friends  which occurred in my case . And do not forget, you have a awesome aperitivo or olives or creams so yummy 😍😍
author: Daydream52204957579

title: Very good choice
text:
Very good experience! A different tasting, in a relaxed atmosphere, tasting great wines, and with views of the Sagrada Familia, incredible! It is very worth it to learn about the different flavors found in Europe. 
The hostesses are very knowledgeable and impeccable. I am very satisfied with my choice.
author: javibruron

title: Wine Tasting inmerse in the Barcelona's culture, a really unique experience!
text:
If you are looking for an immersive Barcelona experience this is the one.

I was there last Friday with my GF and we have to say that the fact of being drinking wine inside a natural home with this amazing panoramic view of the Basilica of Sagrada Familia as a background was outstanding!!!

It was so different than the other tours or activities surrounding this basilica, it felt really genuine.
